messages:
maya (support): Heads-up — during EOM reconciliation for 2026-03, ACME-123 shows a dashboard total of 1,254,321 tokens but the finalized invoice charged 1,289,312 tokens. Also the invoice lists plan tier 'Pro Plus' while dashboard UI shows 'Pro'. Can we triage quickly?

olivia (cs): Is this just one customer or a batch? Any recent plan migrations for ACME-123?

maya (support): Single account for now. Customer says they didn't change plans. We pulled dashboard snapshot at 2026-03-31T23:59:50Z. I attached CSV to ticket (#TCK-4821).

li (billing-eng): I'll start by checking ingestion windows and late backfills. Quick query to compare meter rows vs invoice line:```sql
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as dash_tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE account_id = 'ACME-123' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' AND ts < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

li (billing-eng): also fetching invoice line items:```sql
SELECT invoice_id, line_label, token_count
FROM billing.invoice_lines
WHERE account_id = 'ACME-123' AND period = '2026-03';
```

maya (support): FYI the dashboard snapshot was taken from the UI endpoint (as of 23:59:50). Could there be a cutoff mismatch? @li any known timezone/clockskew issues? :thinking_face: 

li (billing-eng): Not normally. There's a known corner case when post-midnight backfills with late ingestion are applied to invoices but dashboard snapshots were cached earlier. Checking ingestion backfills now.

usage-bot: ingest-backfill-run for account ACME-123 completed at 2026-04-01T00:12:03Z — 34,991 tokens added to metering.events (backfill-id: bf-8842).

olivia (cs): That backfill would explain the token delta. But why did invoice pick up 'Pro Plus' plan? Customer didn't request an upgrade.

tom (finance): Pulling billing audit. Two possibilities: (1) proration/plan migration at commit time (maybe a support action), (2) manual invoice override. I'll check audit logs.

li (billing-eng): Found backfill attribution: bf-8842 was assigned to 2026-03-31 based on event timestamps even though it ran after cutoff, which means invoice generator included it. Dashboard snapshot cached at 23:59:50 didn't reflect it. That explains ~34,991 token difference (1,254,321 + 34,991 = 1,289,312).

maya (support): Great — call that token delta explained. Still need to resolve plan tier mismatch on invoice vs UI.

tom (finance): Audit log shows a plan change event for ACME-123 at 2026-03-31T22:45:10Z from 'Pro' -> 'Pro Plus' with source 'api' and actor 'billing-ops'. Notes: "trial_end override".

olivia (cs): @maya did support or ops trigger that change? We have a support ticket where customer asked pricing clarification, but no requested upgrade.

maya (support): I can confirm support did NOT make that plan change. Ticket history shows only info responses.

sre-oncall: tagging in case this was an automated rule. We had a one-off promo rollout that auto-upgraded a cohort by account tag 'promo-mar'. Is ACME-123 tagged?

li (billing-eng): Checking tags... ACME-123 has tag 'promo-mar' set on 2026-03-31T21:00:05Z by ./tools/promo-assign job (cron). That triggered a scheduled upgrade job which hit the billing API and created the change. The job should have created a log entry but it was misconfigured and did not record a descriptive note.

olivia (cs): So combo of promo tag assignment + cron job = auto-upgrade to Pro Plus and then later backfill added tokens that invoice included. Customer sees unexpected charges and different tier on dashboard.

maya (support): Proposed next steps: 1) finance to review and revert/credit the unwanted plan upgrade if needed, 2) billing-eng to add visibility to promo job logs and ensure it doesn't change billing without explicit audit note, 3) CS to notify the customer with explanation + provisional credit if warranted.

tom (finance): Agreed. I'll open a credit request (CR-7395) and flag for approvals. If upgrade was automated and not consented, expect to credit the delta prorated amount.

li (billing-eng): I'll patch the promo-assign job to include a descriptive audit payload and add a canary check. Will also add a reconciliation check to warn if backfills after cutoff changed invoice totals. Patch ETA 4 hours.

olivia (cs): I'll draft the customer message and include reconciliation timeline + expected credit.

maya (support): Adding final notes and linking ticket TCK-4821 -> CR-7395 -> ENG-PR-514. Thanks all :pray: 

usage-bot: invoice-generation for account ACME-123 (invoice-2026-03-ACME-123) status: finalized at 2026-04-01T02:10:12Z.

tom (finance): Closing loop once credit issued. Leaving escalation open until credit processed.

maya (support): Closing here after credit processed. Will update thread. :white_check_mark:
